title: Structura Reditus Research Library — Relation Record
description: A typed, directed relation between registry entities. Relation type is a controlled taxonomy value from taxonomy/relation_types.yaml.

relation_type.description: Controlled value from taxonomy/relation_types.yaml (validated by the taxonomy validator).

from_id.description: Origin entity: research object or source.

to_id.description: Target entity: research object or source.

declared.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which the relation was declared, with an explicit time-zone designator (Z or +/-HH:MM).

notes.description: Free-text explanation. Supplements, never replaces, the controlled relation type.
